column1: Analysis start 2026-11-01; losses and costs are positive amounts

Negative leverage: the 6.12% going-in cap rate is below the 7.58% loan constant, so debt lowers the yearly cash yield. The levered IRR can still be higher because the sale gain goes to a smaller equity check.

Value-add plan on: 60 units at $12,500 each. The $750,000 renovation reserve is funded with equity at closing (in total cost), each renovation draws its cost, and what is left is returned at sale. The loan is LTV × price and funds none of the plan.
